newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey amends sell-off law to clear legal hitch.
newsitem.headline: Turkey amends sell-off law to clear legal hitch.

text.p: The Turkish parliament has ratified an amendment to its privatisation law to eliminate an objection already being considered at the country's top court, the Official Gazette said.
It said the amendment to the privatisation law was related to the evaluation of companies slated for privatisation and to the format of sell-off tenders.

The amendment also allows deputy prime minister to be part of the High Board of Privatisation, the top decision making body in state sell-offs chaired by the prime minister and participated by five senior cabinet ministers.

The objection request to annul the amended articles was lodged in the Constitutional Court last year by opposition MPs, who said the procedure for the creation of evaluation committees was against the constitution.
The court is expected to decide on the objection request later on Wednesday.
